scope: Interpret the archived Shinaide final checkMesh output and propagate its verdict through a mesh job; no new CFD or GPU run
behavior_added: Mesh jobs interpret the last checkMesh verdict after any orphan/isolated-cell cleanup and expose checkMeshOk, failedChecks and meshWarnings alongside process returncode.
Missing or incomplete final quality reports are marked unverified/failed rather than green.
An explicit checkMesh command that fails or exits without a verdict creates a blocking warning, even when its output contains no parseable physical defect.
React mesh status shows the quality failure and its pre-solve warning gate reads final mesh/checkMesh job state, including late panel mount and SSE-to-poll fallback.
Job quality state is bound to the owning project, so late results from a previous project cannot populate the current warning gate or status panel.
The latest mesh attempt overrides an older disk scan when deciding whether solving is available.
A nonzero mesh process returncode is shown as a run failure before interpreting any missing quality report.
Serial subset cleanup now rechecks the repaired mesh, matching the existing parallel cleanup path, and cleanup is bounded to eight passes.
